_note: ACCT-C12 (owner t124u): which sign-in options a site offers, used only when a vault entry pulled for a sign-in records no sign_in_method and the vault holds no sign-in-options/<site> record. fixed: the site's only way in, known from the site itself. markers: per login method, Playwright selectors that show that option on the site's own sign-in page (hosts); an option counts when one of its selectors matches. A site not listed, a page on another host, or no marker matched is unknown, and the sign-in is refused. liveVerified says whether the markers were seen on the real page; methods outside the reader's values (email, google, x, apple, github, sso, phone, cursor, android) are not listed.

accounts.google.com.note: A Google Account's own credentials sign in only to Google: its sign-in page takes the account's email or phone, then its password (seen 2026-11-11 with no cookies or credentials: one identifier field and Next, no other provider).
